workload_profile.title: Workload Profile (Smart Preset)
workload_profile.description: Smart preset that pre-configures optimal defaults and Talos extensions. 'standard': balanced K8s node; 'control-plane': HA control plane node (HA anti-affinity, startup order=1, hardware watchdog, VM protection); 'storage-node': Ceph/Longhorn/Mayastor node (iSCSI/util-linux extensions, io_uring, cache=none, iothread); 'gpu-ai-worker': NVIDIA GPU/AI node (q35, host CPU, OVMF, NUMA, balloon=false, NVIDIA extensions); 'hardened-secure': Zero-Trust node (OVMF UEFI, Secure Boot, TPM 2.0, VM protection, VirtIO RNG).

node_group.title: Node Group (Topology Filter)
node_group.description: Select a Proxmox node group (auto-discovered from HA Groups, HA Node-Affinity Rules, SDN Zones, Hardware Groups, or config.yaml). Selecting a group automatically updates the Node selector, Storages, Network Bridges, HA Affinity, and PCI/USB Mappings to match that group's capabilities.

node.title: Proxmox Node
node.description: Run the VM on a specific Proxmox node. Leave empty to let the placement strategy auto-select an online node (within 'node_group' if selected).

placement_strategy.title: Node Placement Strategy
placement_strategy.description: Node selection strategy for auto-provisioned VMs, ignored when 'node' is set. 'spread' (default) balances by free memory and CPU, 'fewer-vms' prefers nodes running the fewest VMs, 'round-robin' cycles nodes within a machine request set, 'binpack' packs onto the most-loaded node that still fits.

provisioning_mode.title: Provisioning Mode
provisioning_mode.description: Choose 'iso' (default) to provision from an official Talos Image Factory ISO, or 'clone' to clone an existing Proxmox VM Template.

template_vmid.title: VM Template (Clone Source)
template_vmid.description: Proxmox VM Template to clone when 'provisioning_mode' is set to 'clone' (loaded from templates in your Proxmox cluster).

full_clone.title: Full Clone
full_clone.description: Perform a full disk clone (true) or linked clone (false) when cloning from a Proxmox VM Template.

pool.title: Resource Pool
pool.description: Proxmox resource pool. If left empty, defaults to a pool named after the Omni MachineRequestSet.

auto_create_pool.title: Auto-Create Resource Pool
auto_create_pool.description: Automatically create the specified Proxmox resource pool if it does not already exist.

min_vmid.title: Minimum VMID
min_vmid.description: Optional lower bound for Proxmox VMID allocation (e.g. 5000). When set, the provider allocates the first free VMID >= min_vmid.

max_vmid.title: Maximum VMID
max_vmid.description: Optional upper bound for Proxmox VMID allocation (e.g. 5999).

architecture.title: CPU Architecture
architecture.description: Target CPU architecture for the Talos installation media.

talos_extensions.title: Talos System Extensions
talos_extensions.description: Additional official Talos system extensions to embed in the installation image (siderolabs/qemu-guest-agent is always included automatically).

cores.title: CPU Cores per Socket
cores.description: Number of CPU cores per socket

cpu_type.title: CPU Type
cpu_type.description: QEMU CPU model. Use 'host' for GPU passthrough/HPC or 'x86-64-v2-AES' (default) for live-migration compatibility.

cpu_flags.title: Extra CPU Flags
cpu_flags.description: Optional semicolon-separated CPU flags appended to the CPU model (e.g. '+aes;+avx2;+pdpe1gb').

cpu_limit.title: CPU Limit (Max Cores)
cpu_limit.description: Optional limit on total CPU usage in cores (0 for unlimited).

cpu_units.title: CPU Scheduler Weight (Units)
cpu_units.description: Optional relative CPU scheduler weight for this VM.

balloon.title: Memory Ballooning
balloon.description: Enable memory ballooning. Set to false for GPU passthrough or hugepages.

numa.title: Enable NUMA
numa.description: Enable NUMA topology for better memory locality on multi-socket systems

hugepages.title: Hugepages
hugepages.description: Enable hugepages for reduced TLB misses. Use '1GB' for GPU/HPC workloads

iso_storage.title: ISO Storage
iso_storage.description: Proxmox storage used to download and attach the Talos installation ISO and Cloud-Init config. If omitted, the first enabled ISO-capable storage on the node is used.

storage.title: Primary Disk Storage
storage.description: Proxmox storage pool for the primary VM boot disk (loaded directly from your Proxmox cluster).

storage_selector.title: Primary Disk Storage Selector (Advanced / CEL)
storage_selector.description: Optional CEL expression or storage name for selecting VM disk storage (e.g. 'name == "local-lvm"' or 'storageType == "lvmthin"'). Not required when 'storage' or 'disks' is set.

disk_size.title: Primary Disk Size (GB)
disk_size.description: Primary boot disk size in GB (used when 'disks' list is not specified).

disks.title: Disks (Add / Remove / Resize VM Disks)
disks.description: Flexible list of disks attached to the VM. The first entry is the primary boot disk (scsi0) and subsequent entries are additional data disks (scsi1, scsi2, ...). Supports live addition, removal, and online resizing on existing MachineSets.

storage.title: Storage Pool
storage.description: Proxmox storage pool for this disk

storage_selector.title: Storage Selector (Optional CEL)
storage_selector.description: Optional CEL expression for selecting storage if 'storage' is not explicitly chosen

volume_name.title: Talos UserVolume Name (Auto-Mount)
volume_name.description: Optional volume name (for data disks scsi1+): automatically generates a Talos UserVolumeConfig patch to format and mount this disk at /var/mnt/<volume_name> (ideal for Longhorn/Ceph/LocalPath).

ssd.title: SSD Emulation
ssd.description: Enable SSD emulation (ssd=1) for better performance on SSD/NVMe storage

discard.title: TRIM / Discard
discard.description: Enable TRIM/discard support for thin-provisioned storage

iothread.title: Dedicated IO Thread
iothread.description: Enable dedicated IO thread (iothread=1) for better disk performance

aio.title: Async IO (AIO)
aio.description: Async IO mode. Use 'io_uring' for best performance on modern kernels

backup.title: Include in Backups
backup.description: Include this disk in Proxmox VM backups

replicate.title: Enable Replication
replicate.description: Include this disk in Proxmox storage replication jobs

iops_read.title: Read IOPS Limit (QoS)
iops_read.description: Optional maximum read IOPS limit for this disk

iops_write.title: Write IOPS Limit (QoS)
iops_write.description: Optional maximum write IOPS limit for this disk

mbps_read.title: Read Bandwidth Limit (MB/s QoS)
mbps_read.description: Optional maximum read throughput in MB/s

mbps_write.title: Write Bandwidth Limit (MB/s QoS)
mbps_write.description: Optional maximum write throughput in MB/s

nics.title: Network Interfaces (Add / Remove NICs)
nics.description: Flexible list of network interfaces attached to the VM (net0, net1, net2, ...). Supports both DHCP and static IP / IP Pool Cloud-Init configuration.

bridge.title: Network Bridge / SDN VNet
bridge.description: Proxmox network bridge (e.g. vmbr0) or SDN VNet

mtu.title: MTU
mtu.description: Optional MTU (set 1 to inherit from bridge, or e.g. 9000 for Jumbo Frames)

queues.title: Multiqueue
queues.description: Optional number of VirtIO multiqueue packet queues (recommended: match vCPU count for high throughput)

rate_limit.title: Rate Limit (MB/s)
rate_limit.description: Optional bandwidth rate limit in MB/s

mac_address.title: MAC Address
mac_address.description: Optional static MAC address (leave empty for auto-generated)

trunks.title: VLAN Trunks
trunks.description: Optional semicolon-separated list of allowed VLAN IDs (e.g. '10;20;30')

dhcp4.title: Enable DHCPv4
dhcp4.description: Enable IPv4 DHCP on this interface (automatically defaults to false when static addresses or ip_pool are set unless explicitly enabled).

dhcp6.title: Enable DHCPv6
dhcp6.description: Enable IPv6 DHCP on this interface.

ip_pool.title: Static IP Pool / Range (Auto-Assigned per VM)
ip_pool.description: Optional IP range with CIDR prefix (e.g. '192.168.1.100-192.168.1.150/24' or '192.168.1.0/24') from which each VM in the MachineClass automatically receives a unique static IP via Cloud-Init.

addresses.title: Static IP Addresses (CIDR)
addresses.description: Static IPv4/IPv6 addresses in CIDR notation (e.g. '192.168.1.50/24', 'fd00::50/64').

nameservers.title: DNS Nameservers
nameservers.description: Optional DNS server IP addresses for this interface (e.g. '1.1.1.1', '8.8.8.8').

routes.title: Static Routes
routes.description: Optional static routing entries for this interface.

to.title: Destination Prefix (CIDR)
to.description: Destination subnet in CIDR format (e.g. '10.244.0.0/16' or '0.0.0.0/0')

on_link.title: On-Link
on_link.description: Mark route as directly reachable on link

bonds.title: Network Bonds (LACP 802.3ad / Active-Backup)
bonds.description: Optional Cloud-Init bonded interfaces aggregating two or more VM NICs (e.g. eth0 + eth1 into bond0).

name.title: Bond Interface Name
name.description: Bond interface name inside Talos (e.g. bond0)

mode.title: Bonding Mode
mode.description: Bonding mode ('802.3ad' for LACP, 'active-backup' for failover)

dns_servers.title: Global DNS Servers
dns_servers.description: Optional DNS server IPs applied via Cloud-Init (e.g. ['1.1.1.1', '8.8.8.8']).

dns_search_domains.title: Global DNS Search Domains
dns_search_domains.description: Optional DNS search domains applied via Cloud-Init.

security_groups.title: Proxmox Firewall Security Groups
security_groups.description: Proxmox cluster firewall security groups to automatically attach to the VM (loaded from your Proxmox cluster).

firewall_options.title: Proxmox VM Firewall Policy
firewall_options.description: Configure VM-level Proxmox Firewall policy and anti-spoofing filters (/nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/firewall/options).

replication.title: Proxmox Storage Replication (ZFS / Local HA)
replication.description: Configure automatic Proxmox storage replication (/cluster/replication) for local ZFS storage across nodes.

schedule.title: Replication Schedule
schedule.description: Proxmox calendar event schedule (e.g. '*/15' for every 15 minutes, '*/5' for every 5 minutes)

target_node.title: Target Node
target_node.description: Target Proxmox node for replication (leave empty to auto-select another online node in the group/cluster)

network_bridge.title: Primary Network Bridge (Legacy)
network_bridge.description: Network bridge to attach to the primary NIC (net0) when 'nics' list is not used, ex. vmbr0

vlan.title: Primary NIC VLAN Tag (Legacy)
vlan.description: VLAN tag for primary NIC, set to 0 for none

network_firewall.title: Primary NIC Firewall (Legacy)
network_firewall.description: Enable per-VM firewall (fwbr) on primary NIC. Defaults to true. Set false when L2-broadcast services need traffic to bypass fwbr.

disk_ssd.title: Primary Disk SSD Emulation
disk_ssd.description: Enable SSD emulation (ssd=1) for better performance on SSD/NVMe storage

disk_discard.title: Primary Disk TRIM/Discard
disk_discard.description: Enable TRIM/discard support for thin-provisioned storage

disk_iothread.title: Primary Disk IO Thread
disk_iothread.description: Enable dedicated IO thread for better disk performance

disk_cache.title: Primary Disk Cache Mode
disk_cache.description: Disk cache mode. Use 'none' for best performance with battery-backed storage

disk_aio.title: Primary Disk Async IO
disk_aio.description: Async IO mode. Use 'io_uring' for best performance on modern kernels

scsihw.title: SCSI Controller Type
scsihw.description: SCSI controller model. 'virtio-scsi-single' (default) enables one controller per disk for optimal iothread performance.

machine_type.title: Machine Type
machine_type.description: QEMU machine type. Use 'q35' for PCIe / GPU passthrough.

bios.title: Firmware (BIOS / UEFI)
bios.description: VM firmware. When set to 'ovmf', the provider also creates a 4MB EFI disk on the selected VM storage and enables UEFI Secure Boot / TPM options.

secure_boot.title: UEFI Secure Boot
secure_boot.description: Enable UEFI Secure Boot (requires bios='ovmf'). Enrolls keys in the EFI disk and requests SecureBoot Talos installation media.

tpm.title: TPM 2.0 State Device
tpm.description: Attach a virtual TPM 2.0 state disk (tpmstate0) on the primary storage (useful for Talos disk encryption and Secure Boot).

rng.title: VirtIO Hardware RNG (/dev/urandom)
rng.description: Attach a VirtIO hardware random number generator (rng0) to prevent cryptographic entropy starvation.

watchdog_model.title: Hardware Watchdog Model
watchdog_model.description: Optional virtual hardware watchdog timer model (e.g. 'i6300esb').

watchdog_action.title: Watchdog Action
watchdog_action.description: Action taken by Proxmox if the guest watchdog timer expires.

startup_order.title: Startup / Shutdown Order
startup_order.description: Optional Proxmox startup/shutdown order string (e.g. 'order=1,up=30,down=60' so Control Plane nodes boot before Workers).

vga.title: Display Adapter (VGA)
vga.description: Proxmox display adapter, for example 'std', 'virtio', or 'none'.

serial_console.title: Serial Console (serial0)
serial_console.description: Attach a virtual serial console socket (serial0=socket) for Proxmox xterm.js terminal and kernel console logging.

onboot.title: Start on Node Boot
onboot.description: Automatically start the VM when the Proxmox host node boots.

protection.title: VM Protection Mode
protection.description: Set the protection flag in Proxmox to prevent accidental manual VM removal in the Proxmox UI.

description.title: VM Description / Notes
description.description: Optional description/notes shown in the Proxmox VM Summary panel.

ha.title: High Availability (Proxmox HA)
ha.description: Register the VM as a Proxmox HA resource. Supports both Proxmox VE 7/8 HA Groups ('group') and Proxmox VE 9+ HA Affinity Rules ('rules', 'node_affinity_nodes', 'resource_affinity').

state.title: HA Target State
state.description: HA target state (default: started). Reconciled on every update.

group.title: Proxmox HA Group (PVE 7/8/9)
group.description: Optional Proxmox HA Group name (loaded from /cluster/ha/groups in your Proxmox cluster).

comment.title: HA Comment
comment.description: Human-readable comment on the HA resource.

max_restart.title: Max Restarts
max_restart.description: Max restart attempts on the current node (Proxmox default: 1).

max_relocate.title: Max Relocates
max_relocate.description: Max relocate attempts once restarts are exhausted (Proxmox default: 1).

failback.title: Failback to Preferred Node
failback.description: When true, HA returns the VM to its preferred node once that node is back online.

rules.title: HA Rules (Proxmox 9+)
rules.description: Proxmox HA rule names to add the VM to (loaded from /cluster/ha/rules in your Proxmox cluster).

node_affinity_nodes.title: Node Affinity Target Nodes (Proxmox 9+)
node_affinity_nodes.description: List of Proxmox node names used as the auto-managed node-affinity target set. Automatically populated from 'node_group' when 'node_group' is selected.

node_affinity_strict.title: Strict Node Affinity
node_affinity_strict.description: When true, mark the auto-managed node-affinity rule as strict, so the HA manager will never run VMs outside the configured node set.

resource_affinity.title: Resource Affinity (Spread / Colocate)
resource_affinity.description: Resource affinity direction for the HA rule. 'negative' spreads VMs across different nodes (anti-affinity); 'positive' keeps them together.

additional_nics.title: Additional Network Interfaces (Legacy)
additional_nics.description: Additional network interfaces appended after the primary NIC or 'nics' list.

firewall.title: Firewall
firewall.description: Enable Proxmox firewall for this NIC

ip_pool.title: Static IP Pool / Range
ip_pool.description: Optional IP range with CIDR prefix (e.g. '10.0.20.100-10.0.20.150/24')

additional_disks.title: Additional Disks (Legacy)
additional_disks.description: Additional disks to attach to the VM (scsi1, scsi2, etc.). Prefer using the unified 'disks' list above.

storage.title: Storage Pool
storage.description: Proxmox storage pool for this disk

storage_selector.title: Storage Selector (CEL)
storage_selector.description: CEL expression or storage name for selecting VM disk storage for this disk

disk_ssd.title: SSD Emulation
disk_ssd.description: Enable SSD emulation for this disk

disk_discard.title: TRIM / Discard
disk_discard.description: Enable TRIM/discard support for this disk

disk_iothread.title: IO Thread
disk_iothread.description: Enable dedicated IO thread for this disk

disk_cache.title: Cache Mode
disk_cache.description: Disk cache mode for this disk

disk_aio.title: Async IO
disk_aio.description: Async IO mode for this disk

usb_devices.title: USB Device Passthrough (Add / Remove)
usb_devices.description: USB devices to pass through using Proxmox Resource Mappings (usb0, usb1, etc.)

mapping.title: USB Resource Mapping
mapping.description: Proxmox USB Resource Mapping name (loaded from your Proxmox cluster)

usb3.title: USB 3.0 Controller
usb3.description: Attach the device to the USB 3 controller

pci_devices.title: PCI / GPU Device Passthrough (Add / Remove)
pci_devices.description: PCI devices to pass through using Proxmox Resource Mappings (hostpci0, hostpci1, etc.)

mapping.title: PCI Resource Mapping
mapping.description: Proxmox PCI Resource Mapping name (loaded from your Proxmox cluster)

pcie.title: PCI Express (PCIe)
pcie.description: Use PCIe mode instead of PCI (recommended for GPUs, requires machine_type='q35')

primary_gpu.title: Primary GPU (x-vga)
primary_gpu.description: Set as primary GPU (x-vga=1) for display output

rombar.title: ROM BAR
rombar.description: Enable ROM BAR for device ROM
